merges.resolution_basis: Control Center approved Pittsburgh Stage 1 maintenance: current protected main contains duplicate Evanston physical-venue identities for McGaw Memorial Hall / Welsh-Ryan Arena. Preserve the earlier-established VEN-000229 / welsh-ryan-arena identity, which already carries McGaw Memorial Hall as a historical alias, and retire later duplicate VEN-000258 / mcgaw-memorial-hall.

Control Center approved Pittsburgh Stage 1 maintenance: current protected main contains duplicate Auburn Hills physical-venue identities for The Palace of Auburn Hills / Palace of Auburn Hills. Preserve the earlier-established VEN-000206 / the-palace-of-auburn-hills identity and retire later duplicate VEN-000416 / palace-of-auburn-hills.
